title: Field Service 07
body: Field Service 07 is a 3D model of a pickup truck set up for repair work. It has steps below the doors and a toolbox behind the cab. The last picture shows the doors, tailgate and toolbox open.

images.alt: Blue and ivory fleet pickup seen from the front, with gold side stripes and steps below the cab.
Close view of the tool chest spanning the bed rails behind the cab, with two recessed latches.
Rear view of the pickup with the doors open, the tailgate down and the tool chest lid raised.
